brief:
Shehab Wire reports that Israeli settlement activity in the West Bank has transformed into a comprehensive strategy extending far beyond construction of new units or isolated outposts. The settlement project now functions as an integrated framework designed to control Palestinian land and gradually displace the Palestinian population.

What was once framed primarily as geographic expansion has shifted into a coordinated effort targeting Palestinian presence across the territory. Settlement operations no longer operate as scattered initiatives but as part of a wider systematic approach to territorial control.
